wtdbg2

Accelerate Bench task · Bioinformatics & phylogenetics

wtdbg2 assembles noisy long reads and computes consensus sequences.

Task version2.1.0CPU budget4 CPUsMemory8 GiBAgent budget8 hoursHarbor HubOpen task ↗

Workload

The assembler and consensus caller process generated PacBio- and nanopore-style reads.

Correctness

The verifier checks the graph and layout, genome recovery, contig statistics and k-mer agreement. Replaying consensus from the layout must reproduce the sequence.

Timing

Timing covers the run-only assembly and consensus workflow, with the same process tracing applied to both builds.
